# ball-catalog

Public feed for the [Ball](https://github.com/jsng2026/Ball) iOS app.
**Everything here is generated — do not edit by hand; edits are overwritten.**

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `catalog.json` | The live card-rules feed the app polls (~every 12h). |
| `scraped.json` | The scraper's own view, before human overrides — what the admin panel compares against. |
| `admin/index.html` | The admin panel, served by GitHub Pages. |

Published by `update-catalog.yml` in the private code repo.
To change a rate, use the admin panel — not this repo.
